profile.headline: Software Engineer. Multimedia Designer.
profile.summary:
Software Developer specializing in UX/UI design and implementation, institutional in-house applications, high-impact visuals, interactivity, real-time animation.

My wide-range of interests have forged my skill sets and vision, with proven experience, in Web Development, Graphic Design, Software Development, and Information Technology.

I’m a contemporary Renaissance man swinging between analytical + creative thinking.

positions.title: Software Developer I
positions.description:
• Implement and maintain in-house native and web applications using enterprise languages and frameworks considering the day-to-day needs of our 300+ thousand (yearly) users, including prospect students, students, affiliates, and staff.
• Implementing a Salesforce integration service in .NET 8 to help replace existing legacy applications and data warehouse (or data marts) to use salesforce as a source of truth and integrate with existing user-facing front ends, keeping in mind performance (multi-threading, lifecycle), reliability (services lifecycles, client resilience) and security (managing the server-to-server JWT Bearer Token Authentication Flow).
• Improved team practices through implementing better documentation practices (mostly for IntelliSense) and reference documents for our developers, contractors, and stakeholders in addition to more structured source control history (incremental git commits with more meaningful descriptions and references).
• Implemented of a service-oriented API using .NET 7 minimal APIs for supporting endpoints that will be improving the User Experience and interactive content over the following years.
• Developed cryptographic utilities, such as automatic generation and integration of OpenSSL certificates into Microsoft PFX environments for three different projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps · Programming · JavaScript · C# · .NET Core · Web Development

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
• Maintained, troubleshot, and oversaw 2000+ endpoints running either Windows, Mac OS, or iOS for student use in a vast Windows Active Directory Environment.
• Monitored, tracked, and submitted incidents and action items through helpdesk ticketing software (TeamDynamix), reducing open tickets by 100%.
• Provisioned OS, software and updates using System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) and Jamf Cloud.
• Developed and deployed custom scripts/installers (PowerShell) for managing software without enterprise deployment installers or tools through SCCM, implementing version tracking via Windows registry.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Customer Service · Information Technology

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained front-end (web) and server-side API and services for ONESOURCE Income Tax (web application) following world-class standards and practices using C#, JavaScript, .NET Core (MVC and Web API), SQL, AngularJS.
• Developed new features and expanded third-party libraries to improve the user experience (UX) for the product.
• Read and maintained documentation for OneSource Income Tax global team.
• Followed Agile development practices (two-week sprints) in a Git/Azure DevOps environment for tracking tasks, milestones, bugs, and source code.
• Assisted and utilized a semi-automated CI/CD pipeline on Jenkins and Azure DevOps, to build and deploy changes to testing and QA environments into AWS and Elastic AWS.
• Monitored application logs in DataDog (especially during US tax season to detect bottlenecks or demand spikes).
positions.insights: Skills: Azure DevOps · Programming · JavaScript · C# · .NET Core · API Development · Elastic Load Balancing · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Web Development

positions.title: Programmer Analyst I
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained internal and public software products, including native desktop applications, legacy Visual Basic Applications, ASP.NET Windows Forms sites, SQL Server Reporting Services, and an ASP.NET Core site.
• Developed a REST API client for integrating Oracle NetSuite to USAC custom systems in C# following OAuth 2.0 standards for financial applications.
• Implemented the Front-End of the company’s site in ASP.NET Core, HTML, SASS, CSS, and JavaScript, including interactive UI elements compliant with WCAG 2.0 Level AA standards.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · JavaScript · C# · Web Development

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a variety of custom in-house software solutions ranging from JS/HTML/CSS websites to server-side ASP.NET MVC web applications.
• Stablished a strong modern User Experience for in-house applications that embraces the College’s branding by creating modular and interchangeable web-based styling layouts and asynchronous JavaScript plug-ins served by a proprietary server-side delivery engine that I developed for the college.

positions.title: IT Administrative Technician
positions.description:
• Maintained, troubleshot, and repair Windows and Mac OS administrative systems in an enterprise Windows environment.
• Developed automation utilities in Batch and Bash for repetitive end-point management tasks.  Optimized a PE script used for formatting multiple drives and “hot swapping” drives, increasing up to 600% the throughput of the script.
• Nominated for Student-Employee of the Year 2017 for Truckee Meadows Community College and the State of Nevada.

honors.title: WGU Excellence Award
honors.description:
For exemplary work in the Software II - Advanced C# course.

"The submission present a solid application hat provides the user the functionality to easily manage customer and customer appointment records. The GUI is simple and effective and the GUI interfaces smoothly with the entire application. Good coding practices are exhibited throughout the application and the project is presented in a professional manner."
honors.issuer: Issued by Western Governors University · Sep 2019
